name: BRHT — Fable Fury inventory reality check — IMPORT READY

parameters.query:
SELECT 'inventory_counts' AS table_name, COUNT(*)::int AS rows, MAX(count_date)::text AS latest_date FROM inventory_counts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_status', COUNT(*)::int, MAX(inventory_date)::text FROM inventory_status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_forecast', COUNT(*)::int, MAX(count_date)::text FROM inventory_forecast
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shopify_product_inventory_counts', COUNT(*)::int, MAX(count_date)::text FROM shopify_product_inventory_counts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shopify_product_inventory_daily', COUNT(*)::int, MAX(date)::text FROM shopify_product_inventory_daily
UNION ALL
SELECT 'amazon_product_daily', COUNT(*)::int, MAX(date)::text FROM amazon_product_daily
ORDER BY table_name;

SELECT
  ic.product_id::text AS product_id,
  COALESCE(p.product_name, pl.product_name, ic.product_id::text) AS product_name,
  ic.inventory_count,
  ic.count_date,
  ic.lead_time_days,
  ic.msrp,
  ic.unit_cost,
  ic.updated_at
FROM inventory_counts ic
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id::text = ic.product_id::text
LEFT JOIN product_lookup pl ON pl.product_id::text = ic.product_id::text
ORDER BY ic.count_date DESC, product_name
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  product_name,
  current_inventory,
  days_til_0,
  estimated_stockout_date,
  reorder_by,
  weighted_daily_sales,
  inventory_date,
  cost_value,
  retail_value
FROM inventory_status
ORDER BY product_name
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  product_id::text AS product_id,
  product_name,
  inventory_count,
  estimated_current_inventory,
  count_date,
  days_since_count,
  weighted_blend,
  estimated_stockout_date,
  lead_time_days,
  retail_value_now,
  cost_value_now,
  wholesale_value_now
FROM inventory_forecast
ORDER BY product_name
LIMIT 50;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id)
    product_id::text AS product_id,
    inventory_count,
    count_date,
    updated_at
  FROM shopify_product_inventory_counts
  ORDER BY product_id, count_date DESC, updated_at DESC
)
SELECT
  l.product_id,
  COALESCE(p.product_name, sp.product_name, l.product_id) AS product_name,
  l.inventory_count,
  l.count_date,
  l.updated_at
FROM latest l
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id::text = l.product_id
LEFT JOIN shopify_products sp ON sp.product_id::text = l.product_id
ORDER BY product_name;
